job.title: Python Software Engineer
job.description: We are looking for a Python backend engineer with strong foundation in buildingREST APIs, Pandas, FastAPI framework. big adbamtages if you have experience with AWS and Google Cloud. Remote work is possible for the right candidate.

ai_analysis.summary: This is a fairly good match for a junior-to-mid backend Python profile. The role strongly aligns with Python, FastAPI, REST APIs, and remote work is possible, but it also asks for a stronger backend foundation and mentions Pandas and cloud experience that are not in the candidate CV. The onsite Madrid location is also less ideal than the candidate’s remote preference, though remote may be negotiable.
strengths: Strong overlap with Python and FastAPI
Backend-oriented role fits the candidate’s direction
Remote work is possible according to the listing
gaps: Onsite job in Madrid is less aligned with the candidate’s remote preference
No PostgreSQL explicitly listed in the job, though SQL skills still help
AWS/Google Cloud experience not shown in CV
Could be more competitive if they want a candidate with stronger backend experience
ai_analysis.role_description: Python backend engineer focused on building REST APIs using FastAPI, with additional advantage for Pandas and cloud experience. Remote work may be possible for the right candidate.
ai_analysis.application_advice: Worth applying if the candidate wants a backend Python role and is open to a potentially hybrid/onsite arrangement. Emphasize FastAPI, REST APIs, SQL, Docker, and any backend project work. If remote is essential, clarify that early.
